messages:
maria: Quiet window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC to push kernel + quant profile changes. Owners: @devin + @ashok. Quick checklist I want confirmed before we start: smoke tests, rollback image/tag ready, KV-cache compatibility check, and a monitoring policy for auto-pause. Any blockers?

devin: I can own slot drain + canary rollout. Will run the smoke script and watch latency. Need SRE to claim the window and open the short-lived channel.

ashok: I can own the quant bake and compatibility matrix. Plan to run full staging bake at 14:00 PT today. Two notes: we must enable RUNTIME_QUANT_BAKE=true for the bake job, and the new profile bumps KV cache size by +5% which may affect warm-starts. I'll prepare a quick rollback image (tagging strategy below).

lucas: SRE claim: window reserved under eng-sre. Created temp channel #deploy-1776543219 and added ops alert hooks.

olivia: Quick code-review check — is PR #4722 merged? Needs the runtime flag addition. If not merged, please link; I can approve fast.

devin: PR merged a few mins ago; CI auto-fixed a lint issue. Runtime image tag is redwood/runtime:kw-2.1-quantrc-202703 (pushed to our registry). I also uploaded the canary manifest to s3://redwood-deploy/canaries/1776543219.json.

maria: Smoke checklist (short):
1) endpoint health endpoints OK (/health, /v1/models)
2) p50 latency <120ms, p95 <350ms
3) quality regression <0.5% on sampled eval set
4) no OOM or unexpected GC pauses in logs
5) rollback image/tag available and tested locally

Can each owner confirm which items they will run?

devin: I'll run the smoke script: `./tools/smoke.sh --target canary --report brief` and validate 1/2/4. Running now against the canary manifest.

[devin] command output snippet:
```
./tools/smoke.sh --target canary --report brief
Health: PASS (/health)
Latency p50: 98ms, p95: 210ms
Model compare: sampled 500 requests, miscompare 0.2% (below threshold)
No OOMs in last 5m logs
Smoke result: PASS
```

ashok: Good numbers. I'll validate item 3 (quality) with a targeted eval set for the models affected by quant changes. Also will run a KV-cache warm-start test on a staging slice to confirm no regressions. If anything >0.5% regression, we abort.

olivia: I'll be on-call to execute rollback steps if needed. Rollback command (dry-run first):
```
./ops/rollout -m switch -t stable -i redwood/runtime:kw-2.0-stable --dry-run
```
If dry-run looks good, escalate to immediate switch.

ashok: Rollback plan detail: tag the previous image as `redwood/runtime:kw-2.0-stable` and have the traffic-router job set to route 100% to that tag. I can stage the rollback job now and keep it paused.

sre-bot: Canary monitor created: alert if error_rate > 1% or p95 > 350ms for a 10m rolling window -> auto-pause canary and @channel notify #deploy-1776543219.

lucas: Logging plan: increase log verbosity for runtime workers for first 10 minutes after canary start, add temporary retention to debugging sink for 1h. Also tagging logs with deploy_id=1776543219.

maria: Timezone note: 02:00 UTC = 18:00 PT previous day for some folks. Confirming presence: @devin, @ashok, @olivia (on-call).

devin: I'll be present for the first 30m to validate canary ramps, then hand off monitoring to @ashok for the rest of the window.

ashok: I'll keep an eye on quality metrics and KV-cache behavior. If I see any data drift or >0.5% regressions, I'll trigger rollback.

olivia: I have creds and will execute rollback on request. Also will keep the rollback playbook open and reachable.

maria: Thanks — final: I'll pin this thread and post a 15m remind before the window. If no objections, we proceed with the planned canary start at 02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

lucas: All systems go from SRE side.

maria: Great. See you all in #deploy-1776543219 at T-0.
